text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... When on earth did I wander into a 
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think I spaced out like that, of all 
people—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The statue of the Three Goddesses... The 
atmosphere feels a bit different than 
usual...?
